name: Zhejiang Dafeng Industry Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Dafeng Industry Co., Ltd provides cultural, sports, and tourism industry solutions in China and internationally. The company provides solutions for cultural venues, such as grand theaters, cultural centers, and broadcasting centers, as well as theme parks, conference and exhibition centers, and major events, including intelligent stages, lighting, audio-visual systems, grand theaters, conference systems, intelligent systems, grandstands, seating, and acoustic decorations. It also offers professional hardware, venue construction, intelligent sound and light control, and intelligent competition systems, and overall solutions for sports venues.
